patch.value: The SDK rejects incomplete local package scans before mutation and now formats packed-archive recovery with the caller-selected project or global scope. A global-scope regression test and documentation enforce the behavior.
Truncated project and global directory installs refuse safely, preserve their requested archive retry scope, and leave destinations untouched; packed archives install in that same scope.

The global regression failed before the scope fix and passed afterward; an isolated CLI project refused dry and real global installs without destination writes and activated a packed global archive. Linked test, docs-skills, ESLint and full 9,373-test coverage passed at 100/100/100/100; prior exact-head hosted checks were green before this correction, and new-head CI remains pending.
